name: red-lip-indian-suit-portrait
image_vibe: Serene polished red tailoring with bold lips and a coordinated red-pink studio backdrop
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion portrait for an editorial lookbook or campaign visual.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic HD DSLR editorial portrait of an original adult Indian woman in a red suit against a red-and-pink background.
prompt.main_subject: The adult woman from the required approved-adult face reference, preserving her face and facial structure. She has long dark wavy hair, subtle makeup, defined eyebrows, bright red lips, and a serene expression. She wears a red oversized suit jacket and matching trousers over a black top.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered portrait framing with the subject's face and red tailoring as the focal hierarchy, dark hair framing the face, black underlayer creating contrast, and a coordinated red-and-pink studio background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting with gentle facial modeling, natural skin texture, controlled red and pink color separation, and a calm polished editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic DSLR portrait, 85mm lens, f/4, high-resolution skin and wool texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, sharp eyes and fabric detail, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic HD DSLR editorial portrait of the adult woman from the required approved-adult face reference, preserving her face and facial structure. Give her long dark wavy hair, subtle makeup, defined eyebrows, bright red lips, and a serene expression. Dress her in a red oversized suit jacket and matching trousers over a black top. Use a coordinated red-and-pink studio background, soft diffused lighting with gentle facial modeling, natural skin texture, an 85mm lens at f/4, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, sharp eyes and tailored fabric detail, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, different face, face swap, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text

assets.name: approved adult face identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult subject's face, facial structure, hairline, and natural skin texture; do not alter or replace identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult face reference. Keep the red oversized suit, matching trousers, black top, red-pink backdrop, serene expression, and editorial portrait intent. Identity is required; background and non-essential details may vary.
